sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: MuScriptor is an open-weight, decoder-only Transformer from Kyutai and Mirelo. Trained on 170k real recordings plus 1.45M synthetic MIDIs, it transcribes full multi-instrument mixes into MIDI. The article covers its three-stage pipeline, benchmarks against YourMT3+, instrument conditioning, and setup, with an interactive explainer demo. The post Kyutai Releases MuScriptor: An Open-Weight Decoder-Only Transformer for Multi-Instrument Music Transcription to MIDI appeared first on MarkTechPost .
